text:
ryan: Quick ask — proposing a hybrid reserved commit for Q3 to add 40 H100s in us-west-2 and 8 H100s in eu-central. Hit rate growth + new enterprise customers will need steady capacity.

alisa: +1 on reserve for core inference lanes. can we do a phased payout (6mo ramp) to reduce cash hit? :thinking:

maria: we have a big demo week mid-Aug, need the extra headroom otherwise we throttle demos. timing is tight.

gary: need an updated 12-month cost projection and breakouts (commit vs spot vs burst). also show impact on monthly burn. send to finance review by EOD Friday.

finops-bot: Request received: please attach projected utilization and expected SLOs. Recommended commit mix: 70% reserved / 20% spot / 10% burst for similar profiles.

sophie: curious about alternative: smaller commit + more autoscaling clusters in dedicated. pros/cons?

ryan: notes: primary driver is latency-critical customer traffic — can't risk preemption for 50% of baseline. burst/spot only for async workloads.

sre-bot: flag: cross-AZ placement and egress patterns for eu <> us fallbacks will add ~0.8-1.2c/token equivalent in worst-case; include network egress delta in the model.

billing-bot: Current baseline monthly GPU spend (3 regions) = $1.12M. Projected with proposed commit (amortized) = $1.36M/month. Links: https://billing.internal/runs/2024/q3-commit-proj

alisa: If we do phased 20/20/8 over 3 months we can negotiate a vendor price break and reduce immediate cash. can infra team prepare a deployment plan and SLA targets?

maria: also need a rollback plan if usage doesn't materialize — automatic downscale to shared pool + reassign reserved capacity to lower-priority jobs.

ryan: action items: 1) infra to produce 12mo TCO + utilization assumptions (alisa, sophie) 2) finance to model cashflow + sensitivity (gary) 3) legal/sales to confirm term constraints for enterprise deals relying on this capacity (maria). I’ll compile for exec review Wed.

gary: please cc me on the final spreadsheet. want scenarios: conservative/expected/optimistic.

sophie: will start the infra plan + runbook. estimate 2 days for baseline ops doc, 5 days for full deployment checklist.

ryan: thanks — will follow up with a short deck. :thumbsup:
